# gitea_repository_licenses (Data Source)

Lists detected licenses for a repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_repository_licenses" "example" {
  repository_owner = "my-org"
  repository       = "my-repo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) The repository name.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `licenses` (List of String) Detected repository licenses.
